Cyclic maximum lemma and permutation chamber counting give 1/m and 1/m! volume portions, respectively; their ratio is 1/(m-1)!. Central-cube section formula is a proven prior theorem. Finite rational checker confirms 11715 cumulative vectors and 309 complete edge-sign dual profiles.
